title: loam intake list --json
description: The open issues of the Linear links of a plot, then of its GitHub repos, each the newest change first, then the open tickets of the maps in its links, in number order.

sources.description: Each Linear team or project link of the plot, each GitHub repo of the plot, and each map in its links.

label.description: The repo, such as example/widgets, or the label of the Linear or map link.

error.description: Why Loam could not read the source, or empty.

key.description: ENG-523, #48, owner/repo#48, or map 135. It is the key of a run that starts from the item.

status.description: For a person to read: the Linear state, such as Todo, Open, or Blocked by 135.

priority.description: The Linear priority: Urgent, High, Medium, or Low. Empty for none, and for an item that is not from Linear.

url.description: The web page of an issue, for run start --link, or the path of a ticket file, for run start --ticket.

updated_at.description: The last change in Linear or on GitHub, or empty for a ticket.

run_id.description: The newest run that started from the item, or empty.

repo.description: The ID of the repo of the plot that a GitHub issue belongs to. Empty for a Linear issue and a ticket.

text.description: The first 1200 characters of the Linear description or the GitHub body, trimmed. For a ticket, the text of the file after its title line. Empty for none.

branch.description: The branch name that Linear gives the issue. Empty for a GitHub issue and a ticket.

created_at.description: When the issue was made (RFC 3339). For a ticket, the change time of the file.

in_cycle.description: True for a Linear issue in the active cycle of its team.

assigned_to_me.description: True when the Linear assignee is the person of the key, or the GitHub assignees include the gh user. False for a ticket.

assignee.description: The name of the Linear assignee, or the logins of the GitHub assignees, such as "ada, sam". Empty for no assignee and for a ticket.

in_progress.description: True for a Linear issue whose workflow state type is started.

milestone.description: The project milestone of a Linear issue, or empty.

milestone_order.description: The place of the milestone in its Linear project. 0 for no milestone.
